minimum_content_offset.description: Calculates top-left bounding origin derived from adjusted content insets; shifts downward when UIRefreshControl is pinned

maximum_content_offset.description: Calculates bottom-right bounding origin clamped to min offset if content smaller than viewport

clamped_content_offset.description: Clamps arbitrary proposed contentOffset within valid non-overscrolled scroll bounds

formula.tracking_or_decelerating: contentOffset (active overscroll preserved during touch tracking or deceleration)

adjusted_content_offset_if_necessary.description: Adjusts and clamps current contentOffset during layout mutations (bounds resize, contentSize change, insets update); preserves active overscroll while user is tracking

UIScrollViewContentInsetAdjustmentAutoma.rule: Includes safeAreaInsets if view is scrollable or embedded in a navigation/tab bar hierarchy

UIScrollViewContentInsetAdjustmentScroll.rule: Includes safeAreaInsets along an axis only if content exceeds bounds or alwaysBounce is set for that axis

UIScrollViewContentInsetAdjustmentNever.rule: adjustedContentInset equals raw contentInset; ignores safeAreaInsets completely

UIScrollViewContentInsetAdjustmentAlways.rule: Always adds full safeAreaInsets to contentInset regardless of scrollability

active_drag_overscroll.interaction_state: User finger in contact with digitizer (isTracking == YES, isDragging == YES)
active_drag_overscroll.evaluation_mechanism: Dynamic static evaluation per touch event in handlePan:
active_drag_overscroll.formula_applied: f(x) rational rubber-band equation directly applied to unconstrained pan translation
active_drag_overscroll.time_integration: None (position is strictly kinematically coupled to finger displacement)
active_drag_overscroll.release_transition: Upon touch up, if offset is outside boundaries, initial velocity v0 is measured by 8-sample ring buffer and handed off to _UIScrollViewSpringAnimation

touch_release_overscroll_restitution.interaction_state: User lifts finger while in overscroll state (isDragging transitions to NO, isDecelerating transitions to YES)
touch_release_overscroll_restitution.axis_specific_policy_gating: Evaluates canBounceHorizontal and canBounceVertical independently; non-permitted axes are immediately pinned to equilibrium boundary, while only permitted axes schedule spring restitution

initial_conditions.initial_velocity_v0: Residual finger release velocity sampled from 8-entry pan velocity ring buffer

touch_release_overscroll_restitution.spring_handoff: Restitutes back toward boundary equilibrium via underdamped harmonic oscillator ODE (zeta = 0.90); halts when |x| < 0.5 pt and |v| < 0.5 pt/s

ballistic_momentum_overscroll.interaction_state: Finger released, inertial deceleration animation running (isDecelerating == YES)
ballistic_momentum_overscroll.evaluation_mechanism: Inertial exponential decay stepping via CADisplayLink ticks
ballistic_momentum_overscroll.boundary_collision_detection: Offset trajectory crosses minContentOffset or maxContentOffset during interval [t_n, t_{n+1}]

momentum_handoff_algorithm.step_4_spring_launch: Halt deceleration animation immediately, launch _UIScrollViewSpringAnimation with x0 = 0.0 and initial velocity v0 = v_boundary
momentum_handoff_algorithm.step_5_kinetic_compression: The virtual spring compresses into overscroll up to X_max = abs(v_boundary) / omega_d, then rebounds back to s_boundary equilibrium

ballistic_momentum_overscroll.formula_usage: Momentum overscroll does NOT use the drag rational curve dynamically per frame; it transitions directly to the second-order ODE spring simulation

bounce_back_spring_parameters.harmonic_oscillator_ode: m * x_ddot + c * x_dot + k * x = 0

lifecycle_routine.description: Evaluates closed-form ODE per axis on each frame tick, updates target UIScrollView contentOffset, checks position and velocity settling thresholds, snaps to equilibriumOffset, and clears isDecelerating bit

settling_and_rest_conditions.settling_action: Snap contentOffset to equilibrium boundary and clear isDecelerating bit

bounces.description: Master switch controlling whether contentOffset can exceed minimum/maximum bounds
bounces.when_disabled: Strict clamping to [minOffset, maxOffset]; zero momentum transfer on boundary impact

alwaysBounceVertical.description: Enables vertical overscroll dragging and bounce even if contentSize.height <= bounds.size.height

alwaysBounceHorizontal.description: Enables horizontal overscroll dragging and bounce even if contentSize.width <= bounds.size.width

bouncesZoom.description: Enables rubber-band scaling beyond minimumZoomScale and maximumZoomScale
bouncesZoom.below_min_formula: minScale - ln(1.0 + (minScale - s) / minScale) * c_zoom * minScale
bouncesZoom.above_max_formula: maxScale + ln(1.0 + (s - maxScale) / maxScale) * c_zoom * maxScale

content_smaller_than_viewport.geometry_behavior: maxOffset collapses to minOffset along that axis

scroll_decision_table.bounces_YES_alwaysBounce_YES: Draggable with immediate rubber-band resistance in both directions; springs back to minOffset
scroll_decision_table.bounces_YES_alwaysBounce_NO: Non-scrollable along this axis; pan gestures pass through to parent view; strictly pinned at minOffset
scroll_decision_table.bounces_NO_alwaysBounce_ANY: Non-scrollable along this axis; strictly pinned at minOffset

zero_content_size.handling: Handled symmetrically as content_smaller_than_viewport with 0pt dimension

pull_to_refresh_pinning.top_boundary_shift: minOffset.y shifts downward by refreshControlHeight (typically -60.0 pt)
pull_to_refresh_pinning.stiffness_override: Virtual spring stiffness increases from k = 100.0 N/m to k = 180.0 N/m
pull_to_refresh_pinning.momentum_interaction: Ballistic flings striking the pinned refresh boundary rebound with higher restitution frequency omega_n = 13.42 rad/s
